Genome x PHA-family presence/copy-number matrix, built from the capped annotation tables above.
GTDB taxonomy for every OMDB genome, including the phaC-negative ones, used as the denominator for prevalence rates.
MMseqs2 cluster assignment of all phaC proteins at 50% identity (two columns: representative, member).
MMseqs2 cluster assignment of all phaC proteins at 60% identity (two columns: representative, member).
MMseqs2 cluster assignment of all phaC proteins at 70% identity (two columns: representative, member).
MMseqs2 cluster assignment of all phaC proteins at 90% identity (two columns: representative, member).

Uncapped protein-to-genome membership for phaC. This is the authoritative source for genome counts (38,744 phaC-positive genomes); prefer it over the capped annotation tables whenever counting genomes.
Amino-acid sequences of the phaC cluster representatives.
Catalytic-triad scoring for every phaC protein, by alignment against a 625-column phaC HMM: the residues at the Cys/Asp/His columns and a triad_complete flag.
Class I/II/III HMM scores per phaC protein, with the best-scoring class and whether it clears that model's trusted cutoff.
Per-protein sequence evidence tier: length, best reference, identity, coverage and query-to-reference length ratio.
Best Foldseek hit of each ESMFold model against the folded reference set, with TM-scores (query/target/alignment), coverages and structural identity.
Fold verdict for each of the 255 novel phaC candidates. The active-site columns are intentionally empty: the per-candidate PDBs were not retained, so triad geometry was never measured for this set.
Substrate-channel geometry (LIGSITE-style pocket volume and hydropathy by distance shell) for the Desulfoluna phaC copies.
The same pocket measurement applied to PhaC crystal structures of known chain-length preference, used to calibrate the predictions.
ESMFold predicted structures (2,108 PDB files) for phaC proteins and references. Models, not experimental structures.
TemStaPro thermostability predictions per phaC protein at eight temperature thresholds (40-80 C), joined to genome metadata.
The 255 phaC genes recovered from genomes that the primary annotation called phaC-negative despite carrying more than five other pha genes.
Amino-acid sequences of those 255 candidates.
All candidates from that search, each labelled as a re-find of a QC-removed protein, a re-find of a QC-passing protein, or genuinely new.
Triad scoring for every candidate gene in that search, not only the 255 kept.
The 4,170 phaC-negative genomes with more than five other pha genes that the recovery search targeted.
Sample provenance and coordinates for every OMDB genome.
phaC-positive genomes joined to World Ocean Atlas 2023 annual mean temperature at their sampling coordinate and depth.
The same join for WOA23 salinity and dissolved oxygen.
The companion table behind each published figure, one per figure, so every plotted number can be read without rerunning the pipeline.
